proves.claim: When the item folder path already exists, a claim keeps that folder beside it and moves the spare to the path, never inside the folder.

cli.item-folder-spare.existing-folder-se.why: Without it, a regression that nests the spare inside an existing item folder, crashing every later claim at archive.js, would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: After a claim over an existing checkout at the item folder path, the item folder holds no nested checkout with its own .git.

cli.item-folder-spare.no-nested-checkout.why: Without it, a regression that leaves a nested .git inside an item folder would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With no folder at the item path, a claim on a real repository moves the spare into place on the item branch and sets nothing aside.

cli.item-folder-spare.no-existing-folder.why: Without it, a regression in the ordinary spare move would pass unnoticed.
